description: Land Acquisition - Pitawala, Laggala Pallegama D/S Division, Matale District - Ambanpola, Yatawatta D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific orders (Nos. 31 and 32 of 2024) directing the acquisition of particular land parcels with detailed descriptions of the properties, including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and locations. While it mentions Minister Harin Fernando by name, the core content focuses exclusively on land acquisition procedures and property details without assigning detailed ministerial portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
